title: loom-worker telemetry advertisement verification
observed_behavior: loom-worker telemetry advertisement implementation existed without Deno test modules.
loom-worker main was ahead of origin/main before this work.
intended_behavior: Telemetry-derived worker resources and accelerator advertisements are covered by deterministic tests.
Kind 10100 worker advertisement payloads include telemetry, resources, accelerators, pricing, software, geohash, and duration tags.
Immediate repeated Kind 10100 advertisement publishes produce monotonic created_at timestamps.
